questions.prompt: Which statement gives the core rule for “Unsafe Rust and FFI boundaries”?
options: Rust bindings are immutable unless declared mut.
The programmer must uphold the safety invariant for an unsafe operation.
Use rustup to keep toolchain updates and installed versions explicit.
Cargo is the main tool for creating, building, and testing projects.
questions.answer: The programmer must uphold the safety invariant for an unsafe operation.
questions.explanation:
The programmer must uphold the safety invariant for an unsafe operation.
Why: unsafe permits operations such as raw-pointer dereferencing and some foreign calls that the compiler cannot verify. It does not make code safe: document invariants, minimize the block, and provide a safe wrapper.
